about.title: Saran Nursing Home & Research Centre
about.lead: Chapra ka ek local nursing home, Dr. Neela Singh ki dekhrekh mein.
about.intro1: Saran Nursing Home & Research Centre Bihar ke Saran zile mein Sadhnapuri, Chapra mein ek nursing home hai.
about.intro2: Dr. Neela Singh iski owner hain aur yahan patients ko dekhti hain.
about.help1Body: Online request bhejein, ya clinic ko call ya WhatsApp karein.
about.help2Body: Pata, saath kya laana hai aur kaise pahunchein — sab jaanein.
about.help3Body: Yeh website English, Hindi, Bhojpuri ya Hinglish mein padhein.

doctor.role: Owner aur Doctor, Saran Nursing Home
doctor.lead: Dr. Neela Singh Saran Nursing Home ki owner hain aur yahan patients ko dekhti hain.
doctor.consultBody: Appointment request bhejein. Clinic aapka din aur samay confirm karega. Aap clinic ko call ya WhatsApp bhi kar sakte hain.

services.title: Hamari services
services.lead: Zyada jaanne ya appointment book karne ke liye service chunein.
services.how1: Online appointment request bhejein, ya clinic ko call ya WhatsApp karein.
services.how2: Clinic aapka din aur samay confirm karega.
services.how3: Purani reports aur dawaiyon ke saath clinic aayein.
services.notListedBody: Clinic ko call ya WhatsApp karke poochein.

womensHealth.title: Mahila swasthya consultation
womensHealth.short: Mahilaon ki health problems ke liye doctor se milein.
womensHealth.body: Periods, dard, infection ya mahilaon se judi kisi bhi health problem ke baare mein doctor se baat karein. Doctor check karke aage ke steps samjhayengi.

pregnancyCare.title: Pregnancy care
pregnancyCare.short: Pregnancy ke dauraan regular check-up aur salaah.
pregnancyCare.body: Poori pregnancy mein regular check-up, saath mein tests, khaan-paan aur har stage par kya hota hai, iski salaah.

delivery.title: Delivery care
delivery.short: Delivery ke samay maa aur bachche ki dekhbhaal.
delivery.body: Delivery ke samay aur uske baad ke dinon mein maa ki dekhbhaal. Pehle se planning ke liye pregnancy ki shuruaat mein hi doctor se baat karein.

followUp.title: Follow-up visit
followUp.short: Reports dikhane ya dobara check-up ke liye aayein.
followUp.body: Doctor ki di hui follow-up date par aayein, ya jab nayi test reports dikhani hon.

beforeVisit.day3: Agar nahi aa sakte, to kripya clinic ko call ya WhatsApp karein.

errors.network: Internet nahi hai, ya server tak nahi pahunch pa rahe. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
errors.server_error: Kuch gadbad ho gayi. Kripya dobara koshish karein.
errors.validation_error: Kripya jaankari check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.rate_limited: Bahut zyada koshish. Kripya thoda rukkar dobara koshish karein.
errors.otp_resend_too_soon: Naya code maangne se pehle kripya {seconds} second rukein.
errors.otp_expired: Yeh code expire ho gaya. Kripya naya code maangein.
errors.otp_too_many_attempts: Bahut baar galat code. Kripya naya code maangein.
errors.otp_unavailable: Abhi code nahi bhej pa rahe. Kripya clinic ko call karein.
errors.date_unavailable: Yeh din book nahi ho sakta. Kripya doosra din chunein.
errors.duplicate_booking: Is din ke liye aapki appointment request pehle se hai.
errors.too_many_active: Aapki 3 requests pehle se khuli hain. Aur book karne ke liye clinic ko call karein.
errors.cannot_cancel: Sirf requested appointments online cancel ho sakte hain. Kripya clinic ko call karein.
errors.forbidden: Aapke account ko iski permission nahi hai.
errors.wrong_login: Mobile number ya password galat hai. Aap ek baar ke code se bhi log in kar sakte hain.
errors.password_locked: Bahut baar galat password. Kripya ek baar ke code se log in karein, ya 15 minute baad koshish karein.
errors.invalid_transition: Is appointment ke liye ab yeh step possible nahi hai. List refresh kar di gayi hai.
errors.not_today: Patient ko sirf appointment wale din hi check in kiya ja sakta hai.
errors.changed_elsewhere: Kisi aur ne abhi yeh appointment badla hai. List refresh kar di gayi hai.
errors.no_change: Yeh wahi din aur samay hai.
errors.login_locked: Bahut baar galat password. Kripya 15 minute baad koshish karein.
errors.patient_exists: Is mobile number se ek patient pehle se registered hai.
errors.visit_not_open: Patient ke check in ke baad hi notes likhe ja sakte hain.
errors.follow_up_invalid: Kripya aaj ki visit ke baad, ek saal ke andar ki follow-up date chunein.
errors.slot_passed: Aaj ka yeh samay nikal chuka hai. Kripya baad ka samay ya doosra din chunein.
errors.payment_declined: Card decline ho gaya. Please doosra card try karein ya UPI se pay karein.
errors.payment_failed: Payment nahi ho paya. Please dobara try karein ya doosra tareeka chunein.
errors.nothing_to_pay: Is appointment ke liye kuch pay karna baaki nahi hai.

periods.title: Apne periods samjhein
periods.description: Menstruation ek natural process hai. Kya normal hai yeh jaanne se aap issues jaldi spot kar sakte hain.
periods.heavyBleeding: Bahut zyada bleeding (har 1-2 ghante mein pad badalna)
periods.irregularCycles: Cycles 21 din se chhote ya 35 din se bade
periods.severePain: Dard jo daily activities rok de
periods.tip1: Calendar ya app se cycle track karein
periods.tip3: Hydrated rahein aur iron-rich foods khayein
periods.tip5: Agar kuch galat lage to doctor ko dikhayein

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy care guide
pregnancy.description: Har trimester changes laata hai. Regular check-ups aapko aur baby ko healthy rakhte hain.
pregnancy.firstTrimesterTips: Prenatal vitamins shuru karein, alcohol/smoking avoid karein, pehli appointment book karein
pregnancy.secondTrimesterTips: Anomaly scan, baby move feel karein, active rahein, balanced meals khayein
pregnancy.thirdTrimesterTips: Due date ke paas weekly visits, hospital bag pack karein, birth ke liye prepare hon
pregnancy.reducedMovement: Baby kam move kar raha ho
pregnancy.care1: Baby ki growth aur development monitor karta hai
pregnancy.care3: Nutrition aur lifestyle guidance deta hai
pregnancy.care4: Labour aur delivery ke liye prepare karta hai
